input: Format log date like MM/DD/YYYY from plog table
output: SELECT RIGHT('0' + CAST(MONTH(DATEADD(DAY, DATEDIFF(DAY, '19000101', log_date) - 81088, '20230101')) AS VARCHAR), 2) + '/' + RIGHT('0' + CAST(DAY(DATEADD(DAY, DATEDIFF(DAY, '19000101', log_date) - 81088, '20230101')) AS VARCHAR), 2) + '/' + CAST(YEAR(DATEADD(DAY, DATEDIFF(DAY, '19000101', log_date) - 81088, '20230101')) AS VARCHAR) AS formatted_log_date FROM dbo.plog;

input: Show purchase log with formatted date from plog
output: SELECT prod_cd, pur_num, hdl_chg, RIGHT('0' + CAST(MONTH(DATEADD(DAY, DATEDIFF(DAY, '19000101', log_date) - 81088, '20230101')) AS VARCHAR), 2) + '/' + RIGHT('0' + CAST(DAY(DATEADD(DAY, DATEDIFF(DAY, '19000101', log_date) - 81088, '20230101')) AS VARCHAR), 2) + '/' + CAST(YEAR(DATEADD(DAY, DATEDIFF(DAY, '19000101', log_date) - 81088, '20230101')) AS VARCHAR) AS log_date FROM dbo.plog;
